=== about
Refresh events with the same selector inside the debounce window make one request; another selector makes its own.
=== page
<div id="cart" ypy-get="/cart">0</div><div id="clock" ypy-get="/clock">0</div>
=== input
event: ypy-refresh
data: selector #cart
data: debounce 60

event: ypy-refresh
data: selector #cart
data: debounce 60

event: ypy-refresh
data: selector #clock
data: debounce 60

event: ypy-refresh
data: selector #cart
data: debounce 60

=== dom
<div id="cart" ypy-get="/cart">1</div><div id="clock" ypy-get="/clock">2</div>
=== respond
/cart => 1
/clock => 2
=== requests
GET /cart
GET /clock
